title: NGAP: append SMF PDU in column info
description: This change will append PDUs from TS38.413 ch9.3.4 to column info

notes.body:
Having problem with segment fault, can't find why..

```
(gdb) f 0
#0  0x00007ffff1b856a2 in proto_item_append_text (pi=0x555559688c60, format=0x7ffff2bd1189 " (%s)") at /wireshark/epan/proto.c:7429
7429		TRY_TO_FAKE_THIS_REPR_VOID(pi);
(gdb) f 1
#1  0x00007ffff173b015 in set_message_label (actx=0x7fffffff9020, type=76) at /wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-ngap.c:3304
3304	    proto_item_append_text(top_tree, " (%s)", label);
(gdb) f 2
#2  0x00007ffff174f216 in dissect_ngap_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer (tvb=0x55555870ecf0, offset=0, actx=0x7fffffff9020, tree=0x555559689cc0, hf_index=149895) at /wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-ngap.c:17221
17221	  set_message_label(actx, MTYPE_PDU_SESSION_RESOURCE_SETUP_REQUEST_TRANSFER);
(gdb) f 3
#3  0x00007ffff1760767 in dissect_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer_PDU (tvb=0x55555870ecf0, pinfo=0x7fffffffa9f8, tree=0x555559689cc0, data=0x0) at /wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-ngap.c:24777
24777	  offset = dissect_ngap_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer(tvb, offset, &asn1_ctx, tree, hf_ngap_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer_PDU);
```

```
(gdb) f 0
#0  0x00007ffff1769a86 in set_stats_message_type (pinfo=0x7fffffff9978, type=76) at /wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-ngap.c:26997
26997	    priv_data->stats_tap->ngap_mtype = type;

17222	  set_stats_message_type(actx->pinfo, MTYPE_PDU_SESSION_RESOURCE_SETUP_REQUEST_TRANSFER);
(gdb) f 2
#2  0x00007ffff1760767 in dissect_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer_PDU (tvb=0x5555594ca0a0, pinfo=0x7fffffff9978, tree=0x0, data=0x0) at /wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-ngap.c:24777
24777	  offset = dissect_ngap_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer(tvb, offset, &asn1_ctx, tree, hf_ngap_PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer_PDU);
```

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14166/diffs?diff_id=905048432&start_sha=da170604c1ea1b8d10a5da27d4bccf3ef3d245d6#59b206779dccd4d4f9a865777adaa59ed56bae7f_26999_26996)

Why specifically this PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer SMF IE while there are plenty of others existing? Moreover the stats were designed for top level NGAP messages as specified in 38.413 chapter 9.2 and not for IEs.

if the idea is to fill the info column from a Nf interface, we should differentiate whether the IE decoding function is called from the NGAP dissector itself or not, to conditionally display the IE name (and not clutter the NGAP message decoding with SMF/MB-SMF IEs). And we should put all the names found in chapter 9.3.4 and 9.3.5, not using the tap stats framework that is used for NGAP messages (and not IEs).

Started with PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer as this is the most common one, but failed already on this. When this segment fault is solved I will continue with full list of PDUs. Okej, so stats was not really neeed, then it can be removed. Yes the purpose was to get the PDU info in column info. When payload contains HTTP2/JSON/NGAP/NAS-5G, NGAP is missing in the column info

Need to find how to add this to the generated PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer_PDU instead
Or not, this looks like its correct

changed this line in [version 9 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14166/diffs?diff_id=906189397&start_sha=fabac56e4d3fa6fe8825db371d1645dce9ba8a2f#5ed3cf08f3e64cb083487813b8a510584072ff3d_2829_2829)

This function seems useless. Why not add directly the call to col_append_sep_str() in each function instead of going through this value_tring array? it was required for the NGAP messages only because of the tap.
Moreover IMHO we should not put those extra labels if the parent dissector is NGAP, as indicated previously.

Sure, can put the label directy. Regards to not putting extra label if dissector is NGAP, yes I see that ngap_n2_ie_type_dissector_table is used there too.. what would be the best way to different or know it's now used by media_type instead

changed this line in [version 9 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14166/diffs?diff_id=906189397&start_sha=fabac56e4d3fa6fe8825db371d1645dce9ba8a2f#eb4a5fd9858e3797f8d46ac6419bc7d39b55922d_637_560)

```
proto_ngap != GPOINTER_TO_INT(wmem_list_frame_data(frame))
```

This part is true when NGAP N2 Ie is handle in a MIME multipart, so no column info appended
So what is the packet content in that case, and what are the protocols listed in the frame? Without an example it's difficult to know what you are doing.
N2 interface is the NGAP interface between the AMF and NG-RAN so you should have a full NGAP message here and in that case I do not see the need to put each sub PDU in the info column.

Let's see,will fix a capture with random data :smile:

[http2_mime_nas5g_ngap.pcap](/uploads/72b5b3e677749e2ce42411cf7419488b/http2_mime_nas5g_ngap.pcap)

Here you can see ngap missing in the cloumn info
as we are in NGAP dissector is should be fine to add label, right?

I do not want to have "PDUSessionResourceSetupRequest, PDUSessionResourceSetupRequestTransfer" printed when you have a NGAP message: it clutters the info column with useless information.

For now we might only add the label when called from a JSON context for example (as you initially suggested)
JSON works fine, even tried to it better and look up "mime_multipart", but that wouldn't worked.
